macro: Middle East tensions dominate the overnight tape: Iran says the Strait of Hormuz stays shut until the U.S. meets interim deal conditions, the UAE says two missiles were detected launched from Iran and imposed a financial embargo, and oil is up about 1% near a three-week high as tanker traffic through Hormuz slows. Meanwhile U.S. government debt yields are surging at a bad time, with the 30-year hitting a 19-year high, pressuring equities and driving a sharp selloff in chip names. Wall Street futures are roughly flat after the tech rout, with Iran risk and retail earnings in focus. Separately, DOJ unsealed charges against 17 hackers in an Iran-backed campaign and U.S. authorities warned Siemens devices could be hacked amid fears Iran is breaching water plants.
internals_narrative: Defensive and rate-sensitive-adjacent groups led with Communication Services +1.3%, Pharma +1.2% and Energy +1.1%, while Materials -1.2% and Technology -0.6% lagged; semis were the standout drag with INTC -6.6%, AMD -4.3%, TXN -3.8% and AVGO -3.2%, versus gainers INTU +4.4%, LLY +3.6% and ADBE +3.6%.

ticker_notes.INTU: Deutsche Bank maintained Buy but cut its price target to $425, while Piper Sandler reiterated Underweight at $250.
ticker_notes.LLY: Rival Novo Nordisk began testing lower doses of its Wegovy weight-loss pill, a competitive read for Lilly's obesity franchise.
ticker_notes.ABBV: Wells Fargo maintained Overweight and raised its AbbVie price target to $300.
ticker_notes.JNJ: An EVP exercised Johnson & Johnson options worth $2.38M.
ticker_notes.NOC: Elizabeth Warren is targeting defense contractors' ~$100 billion in shareholder payouts, saying 'this needs to stop.'
ticker_notes.GILD: Partner Assembly Biosciences flagged Gilead advancements on GS-1179 and ABI-6250 as a bullish signal.
ticker_notes.INTC: Intel led decliners as chip names crumbled amid a broad selloff driven by the 30-year yield hitting a 19-year high.
ticker_notes.ETN: Eaton and Trane Technologies announced a collaboration to boost AI-data-center efficiency, tied to the Nvidia AI buildout.
ticker_notes.META: Meta shares climbed even as a landmark antitrust trial threatens up to $1.4 trillion in penalties.
ticker_notes.AMD: AMD moved as Nvidia won a limited China reprieve, with H200 chips reaching ByteDance and Tencent as Beijing eases AI curbs.
ticker_notes.TXN: Cantor Fitzgerald reiterated Neutral on Texas Instruments with a $340 price target.
ticker_notes.NEM: Gold rallied to $4,500 as the dollar sank, a tailwind for the miner.
ticker_notes.AIG: Cantor Fitzgerald maintained Overweight on AIG while lowering its price target to $90.
ticker_notes.AEP: Carl Icahn trimmed his AEP stake; Truist maintained Buy but cut its target to $139.
